notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33845009/16a0b9b99936a24e60099510a553c54b42abc34c.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

after a very long time, we decided to leave early access with our game.

The game is in a very stable state and basically nothing prevented this for a long time.

[b]Version 1.0 now includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly adjusted performance - in some situations..
[*]Archers now gain experience points and advance a level.
[*]With the new level, they change the color of the hood + increase their attack.
[/list]

[b]01.02.001:[/b]
[list]
[*]There is no longer an unexpected memory leak and the game no longer crashes.
[/list]

[i]Game performance still has bad results in the final stages of the game (when you have a lot of archers or you are in a 50+ game day).
We will continue to work on this performance solution for the final fix.[/i]

We also wanted to implement some extra features we planned. But unfortunately, it was not possible to implement these functions into an existing project without breaking the current version of the game a lot.

Without these features, the game is still fun and can be played without any problem.
We may be implementing the features that were planned in some future updates (we will see how everything can be solved.).

We believe that you will enjoy the game anyway;)
Many thanks for all your support.

notes.title: Update 0.56.001
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33845009/55500c686175bc26d432934d849fe8377e3e7aa7.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Finally, we managed to complete the last major translations of the game.
And for these languages:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] German
[*] Polish
[/list]

It was necessary to make some adjustments to the game code and the logic for the game's overall translations. But at this time, this complex and uncomfortable (for development - but all the more important) feature is already complete. It took us a little more time than we expected (plus a little rest from the work;)).

But most importantly, this is our first finished major task, and now we finally can add new content and fine-tune the game.

Thanks a lot for all your support.

Enjoy the game!

[h1]And if you like our game, don't forget to write a small review here on Steam;)[/h1]

Thanks a lot.

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
In the game, there is a sharp decline in FPS if you have more than 50-80 archers.
We know about this problem - and we know how to solve it (but it is a big hit that can not be done from day to day). This drop in FPS does not, however, fundamentally interfere with the basic playability of the game.

notes.title: Update 0.55.001 - 003
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33845009/8554ee1ce5a9f19818ac53ec777bb04b30bd54cc.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

so we have the first week of the game available to the public.
We want to thank you and your support. 

And also we ask you to leave a small review here on Steam - it's really crucial for the game, and the game needs more than 50 reviews from Steam buyers (not from keys - Humble Store etc.). Otherwise, Steam will stop showing it to new potential customers (which happened yesterday). Therefore, if you find a time, we will be very happy.
We will certainly welcome also reviews from key  (if you bought the game outside of the steam or obtained another way).

We are still focusing on minor fixes or language support (depending on how our fans come to us and offer translation assistance).

And we follow your comments and ideas.

Above all, we want to thank the "Alis" fan who create into proofreading of the Japanese translation. We have implemented this proofreading, although the final translation is still in production. So perhaps this tiny proofreading will come in handy for some Japanese players.

[h1]0.55.001 - 002[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for the Portuguese language (still subject to final proofreading).
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Portuguese.
[*]Japanese language proofreading - it's not a final translation.
[/list]

[h1]0.55.003 - March 29[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for the Polish language (still subject to final proofreading).
[*]Next Japanese language proofreading.
[*]Next Portuguese language proofreading.
[*]Next Korean language proofreading.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Japanese.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Polish.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for German.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Danish.
[/list]

Here is a summary of all the previous mini edits (we didn't create a notify for these small hotfixes):
[h1]0.54.001 - 007[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue when the native resolution was a little unique/non-standard this has caused a bad reading of the game's global settings.
[*]Modified mouse cursor behavior in software support.
[*]Added an option to enable hardware mouse cursor support (in settings - graphics section)
[*]Fixed issue with "Bloom Off" settings - now correctly turn off any blurring of the image.
[*]The game is already running in the background.
[*]Pet now collects coins faster.
[*]The island code is already correctly displayed in the pause menu (when the island was created via the editor).
[*]Fixing NPC behavior if there is a problem with their position on the map - NPCs no longer travel to water;)
[*]Fixed problem with wall price on Hard difficulty.
[*]Fixing a trader's behavior - if his camp is too far from the city center.
[*]Fixed issue with correct day setting for changing seasons.
[*]Fixed a small bug with spawn new animals.
[*]Added support for Korean language.
[*]Added support for the Italian language.
[*]Added support for the Turkish language.
[*]Corrections in Spain translation.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Turkish.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for Korean.
[*]Some proofreader of a German translation.
[*]Some proofreader of a English translation.
[*]Some proofreader of a Spain translation.
[/list]

Enjoy the game!

[h1]And if you like our game, don't forget to write a small review here on Steam;)[/h1]

Thanks a lot.

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
In the game, there is a sharp decline in FPS if you have more than 50-80 archers.
We know about this problem - and we know how to solve it (but it is a big hit that can not be done from day to day). This drop in FPS does not, however, fundamentally interfere with the basic playability of the game.

notes.title: Day one mini hotfixs - 0.53.002 - 005
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

based on your suggestions and watching new players on youtube, etc. We've made a smaller quick update - rather a hotfix.

[h1]0.53.002[/h1]

[list]
[*]The power of the enemy is slightly reduced to normal difficulty.
[*]Fixed issue with initial connection to game statistics - now you can see weekly TOP 10, etc.
[*]If the position of your character is incorrectly saved, the position will be repaired when the game is loaded.
[*]Adapted Coin Physics Behavior - There is no big shattering of coins around the world if you drop them a lot.
[*]Upgraded translations for Ukrainian.
[*]Added translations of Achievement for French and Spanish.
[/list]

[h1]0.53.003 - 005[/h1]

[list]
[*]The removed wall no longer blocks incoming enemies.
[*]Fixed text overflow in for some language mutations on the campaign map.
[*]Minor fix of some texts.
[*]Fixed minor bug for coin behavior, when coins are dropped on the ground.
[/list]

Enjoy the game!

And if you like our game, don't forget to write a small review here on Steam;)

Thanks a lot.
